description.value: Mountain City Cycle has been the Comox Valley's full-service bicycle shop since 1998, stocking a broad range of bikes from Giant, Liv, Devinci, and Surly — including the Surly Bridge Club, purpose-built for loaded touring on and off pavement. The repair workshop handles everything from basic tune-ups to suspension overhauls and offers free walk-in estimates on any work. Touring-relevant accessories including racks, fenders, packs, panniers, and hydration gear are stocked in-store and available for local delivery.

raw_osm.description: Since 1998, we have been the Comox Valley's one-stop shop for bike sales, service, and accessories.
raw_osm.name: Mountain City Cycle

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active full-service bicycle shop operating since 1998 with a dedicated repair page stating 'we do everything in terms of bike repairs and maintenance' and inviting walk-in estimates, corroborating OSM's service:bicycle:repair=yes. Touring-relevant inventory is evidenced by the Surly Bridge Club listing (explicitly described as a versatile touring bike with rack/pannier mounts) and accessories including racks, fenders, and packs/racks/baskets. A minor address discrepancy exists: OSM records '120A 5th Street' while the website consistently shows '120 Fifth Street, Courtenay, BC V9N 1J4', omitting the 'A' unit suffix.
